opening.argument: The speaker introduces DreamSpace as a platform for generating applications with AI, deploying them to blockchains, and monetizing a business. The invitation to build applications and show growth presents incentives as part of that ecosystem model. Even the discussion of dollars, credit cards, and tokens describes payment options for an example business app. This is a conference presentation about technology and product capabilities, not a request for viewers to send money, provide credentials, or enter a deceptive transaction. The growth claims remain promotional: they do not establish user earnings, eligibility, payout terms, or outcomes.

citations.quote: Generate applications using AI. Deploy apps to any blockchain, monetize your business on crypto rails or not on crypto rails.
Come build, come show user growth, come show revenue growth and for that you'll get incentives based off of growth.
You can pay me in dollars. You can run a credit card in Stripe. You can pay me in linked tokens. You can pay me in space and time tokens.
